issue.description: The GitHub issue number this stream worked.

branch.description: The branch the work is on.

pr_url.description: The PR opened for this stream, or null if none was opened.

state.description: done: PR open and validated. blocked: cannot proceed without a change outside this stream's scope (say what). needs_owner: a question for the owner is in /run/stream/owner-questions.md.

summary.description: What was done, what was verified, what is left. Under 120 words.

token.description: The fencing token from the brief, quoted exactly.
